cases.disposition_reason: showcase --page overview opens Overview through parse_page and App::open_page in src/bin/showcase/main.rs. The settled screen is Playground, with Tokens and principles behind every component and the live widget, at 120×40. OverviewPage in src/bin/showcase/pages/overview.rs owns that page. finish sends Ctrl+Q. QuitKeys::classify in src/ui/leave.rs returns LeaveKey::Quit for Ctrl+Q, and the process exits 0. Launch::new leaves the clock off.
cases.return_path: Overview stays up, then finish sends Ctrl+Q and the process exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: src/runtime.rs job_control installs on_tstp for SIGTSTP, which is 18 on macOS. The handler only stores a flag. The event loop calls TerminalSession::suspend when take_request is set. suspend leaves the terminal, stop_self raises SIGTSTP, and reenter restores the screen. tests/functional/support.rs keeps App.session private, so a case cannot call session.execute. The operation this probe can send is Operation::Key through App::key. The only public Operation::Signal is kill_child with name KILL, which terminates the child, and this case does not call it. tuiscotti-tui-test 0.2.1 Pty::signal accepts INT by writing a Ctrl-C byte, and TERM, KILL, and QUIT by killing the child. TSTP and CONT return unsupported signal. There is no public continue. App::key("ctrl+z") on showcase --page overview at 120×40 left the process running. For 800ms the screen stayed Playground, with Tokens and principles behind every component and the live widget, and without App shell. A following ] still opened Chrome, which showed Brand lockup and App shell › and hid the overview blurb, so the child was not stopped. finish then exited 0. A process that stays in the UI did not suspend, and a killed process is not a resume. No baseline was captured.
cases.action_sequence: Launch showcase --page overview --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40 with the clock off. Send ctrl+z through App::key. The screen stays on Overview. Send ]. Chrome opens. finish exits 0. Do not send KILL.
cases.expected_results: The screen and modes return only after a real stop and continue. App::key("ctrl+z") leaves the process running on Overview. A following ] still opens Chrome, and finish exits 0. If the API cannot suspend, the row stays BLOCKED with the API evidence.
cases.forbidden_effects: A killed process is reported as resume.
